SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL
S. M. C. REGISTRY
No. D 7769
Date 3 / 3 / 37

March 3, 1937. Afternoon Translation.

Ta Kung Pao and other local newspapers:-

THE NURSING TRAINING SCHOOLS

The Bureau Of Health and the Bureau of Social
Affairs issued the following joint notice yesterday:-

"It has been found that certain persons, using
the name of the nursing tranining school, are attempting to
defraud the public. Persons who establish nursing training
schools must possess special qualifications.

"It is hereby notified that any person who
desires to establish a nursing taining school must first
register with the Bureau of Social Affairs. Its insteructors
must be examined by the Bureau of Health. Persons who
have already opened nursing training school should also
observe this procedure. Offenders will be dealt with."

上海公共租界工部局
工部局档案室
编号 D 7769
日期 37年3月3日

1937年3月3日。下午译文。

《大公报》及其他本地报纸：

护士训练学校

卫生局与社会局昨日联合发布如下通告：

“经查，有某些人假借护士训练学校之名，企图欺诈公众。设立护士训练学校者必须具备特殊资格。

“特此通知，凡欲设立护士训练学校者，须先向社会局注册。其教员须经卫生局考核。已开设护士训练学校者亦应遵守此程序。违者将予查处。”

issued from the Health Administration of the
Executive Yuan of the National Government on
May 25, 1933, and a similar permit from the

Translation of Despatch No.108 from the Shanghai
City Government Police Bureau.
7769
/ 2 37

January 30,1937.

To the Shanghai Municipal Police.

According to information received by the
City Government from the Aviation Society, the
Shun Pao on June 15,1936, published a report regarding
the anti-poisonous gas practice exhibition by the
People's Anti-Poison First Aid Research Society.
This society was not registered and its activities
were improper. The Shun Pao on November 12 published
a report regarding a book entitled "Knowledge for
Aerial Precautions" published and sold by the People's
Aerial Research Society. On December 5 the Sin Wan Pao
published an advertisement by the People's Ambulance
Training Institute, another illegal body. Investigations
were later made and it was ascertained that the last
named body had an office at 359 Burkill Road and the
promoters were Wong Chueh Ying, Chen Bai Yuen, Tsang
Yue Ming, Kao Pah Hwa, Koo Yee Sz. Wong Chueh Ying said
that his Institute had applied for registration to the
City Government Social Bureau and the Tangpu.

Tsang Sz Yao, publisher of the People's Aerial
Research Society's magazine "Knowledge for Aerial
Precautions", stated that his Society had removed to No.30,
Yuen Chong Li, Route Vallon, French Concession. He
published 10,000 copies of the first and second issues
of the "Knowledge for Aerial Precautions" and that after
all copies had been sold, no further issue would be
printed.

1937年1月30日。

致上海公共租界工部局警务处。

据市政府从航空协会获悉的情报，《申报》于1936年6月15日刊登了一篇关于民众防毒急救研究会举行防毒演习展览的报道。该会未注册，其活动不当。《申报》于11月12日刊登了一篇关于国民防空研究会出版并销售《国民防空须知》一书的报道。12月5日，《新闻报》刊登了另一非法团体民众救护训练所的广告。后经调查，查明该最后提到的团体办公地点位于伯基尔路359号，发起人为王菊英（Wong Chueh Ying，即王菊影）、陈百源（Chen Bai Yuen，即陈培元）、张裕民、高伯华、顾伊士。王菊英称，其训练所已向市政府社会局及党部申请注册。

国民防空研究会杂志《国民防空须知》出版人蒋士尧（Tsang Sz Yao，即蒋士尧）称，其会已迁至法租界华伦路元崇里30号。他出版了《国民防空须知》第一、二期共一万册，并称售罄后不再加印。

As regards the People's Anti-Poison Research Society,
this was established by one Zien Zee Bih and is now
being controlled by Yang Tsoo Lung. The office is in
French Concession.

The foregoing societies are illegal bodies as they
are not properly registered with the Authorities.
Furthermore all aerial societies or offices should be
controlled and operated by the Aviation Society.
It is therefore requested that these societies and
their activities be suppressed. As regards the book
"Knowledge for Aerial Precautions", an application should
be sent to the Ministry of Interior for censorship and
registration.

Apart from writing to the authorities concerned in this
matter, this letter is forwarded with the request that
the above mentioned societies be suppressed.

Soo Lee Bing,
Chief Secretary,
for Commissioner of Police Bureau.

C. P. -
J. Bk. 1/2
page_data.zh:

关于民众防毒研究会，该会由钱子必（Zien Zee Bih，音译）一人建立，现由杨祖龙（Yang Tsoo Lung，音译）控制。办公地点在法租界。

上述社团均为非法团体，因其未在当局正式注册。此外，所有防空社团或机构均应由航空协会控制和运作。
因此，请求取缔这些社团及其活动。关于《国民防空须知》一书，应向内政部申请审查和注册。

除致函有关当局处理此事外，特将此函转呈，请求取缔上述社团。

苏立炳，
秘书，
代公安局局长。

C. P. -
J. Bk. 2月1日
